title: Wandering
description: A wandering camera drifts near the subject as curiosity, a search without a target yet. The move is not a motivated reframe to a known fact; looking itself is the action until something is found.

sections.title: Narrative function

blocks.text: Looking is the action. Openings, parties, streets: the lens behaves like a guest who has not decided what matters.
Discovery is the point, not a pre-aimed hero. Once the camera knows the target and drives at it, the wandering is over.
A hunt is a track. A tour that never finds anything is also empty: curiosity still needs a world worth searching.

sections.title: How it works

blocks.text: Steadicam or handheld, human height, no locked axis. Speed is uneven on purpose.
Let the frame glance off extras, corners, and unfinished business, then arrive. Prompt: Wandering camera near [Subject], unmotivated drift that becomes curiosity, a search without a target yet.

sections.title: When to use it

blocks.text: Use it when the scene is a search: an opening that discovers a location, a camera that has not chosen a side. Do not wander through a scene whose power geography is already known.

sections.title: Compared with similar shots

blocks.text: Handheld is a body and a shake; it can still be aimed. Steadicam is a float that can wander or can be a laser.
Wandering is the motive: discovery, not targeting. A Pan from sticks surveys from one point; wandering translates.

sections.title: In film

blocks.text: Children of Men openings let the camera discover a street before the event lands. The Player's start wanders a lot as a search that becomes a sentence.

sections.title: What usually goes wrong

blocks.text: The usual wrong cousin is a hero-cam walk or a clean track. The tell: the subject is already centered and inevitable.
The fix: drift, miss, then find; let the space exist before the aim.

sections.title: Questions

blocks.text: What is Wandering in film?
A wandering camera searches a space without a chosen target yet. Looking is the action; discovery comes after the drift.
Wandering vs Handheld
Handheld is a mounting and a shake. Wandering is a motive: curiosity rather than a pre-aimed subject. A wander can be smooth on a vest.
When should I use Wandering?
Use it for openings and searches, when the camera has not chosen a side. Do not wander a scene whose blocking is already the point.
How do I prompt Wandering for AI image or video?
Write a drift that discovers rather than targets. Example: Wandering camera near [Subject], unmotivated drift that becomes curiosity, a search without a target yet.
